ja: 欧米諸国でも高い人気を誇るアニメ『鋼鉄ジーグ』の主役機「鋼鉄ジーグ」が、アレンジシリーズ「INFINITISM」第四弾として登場！
■メカデザイナー柳瀬敬之氏デザインアレンジ。頭長高175mmにINFINITISMの世界観を盛り込むことに成功。
■ギミックや細部の作り込みなど、プラモデルオリジナルアレンジも搭載。
■マッハドリル装備時の全高は230mm超となる大型キット。
■シールを使わず、組み立てるだけでカラフルな仕上がり。
■アクションベース付属で飛行状態での展示が可能。
■両手指を組んだナックルボンバー再現パーツとエフェクトも同梱。
en: The main character "Kotetsu Jeeg " from the anime " Kotetsu Jeeg ", which is very popular in Western countries, is now available as the fourth installment of the arrangement series " INFINITISM"!
• Designed and arranged by mechanical designer Noriyuki Yanase. Succeeded in incorporating INFINITISM's world view into a head length of 175mm.
• Equipped with original plastic model arrangements such as gimmicks and detailed details.
• A large kit with a total height of over 230mm when equipped with a Mach drill.
• Colorful finish with just assembly without using seals.
• Comes with an action base so it can be displayed in flight.
• Knuckle Bomber reproduction parts and effects are also included.
